high_level_description: This image is a comparison of satellite images of Greece taken on two different dates: August 1, 2021, and August 11, 2021. The top image shows the Greek landscape with lush green vegetation, indicating a healthy environment. The bottom image, taken just ten days later, reveals significant changes, with large areas appearing brown and scorched, suggesting widespread forest fires or other forms of land degradation. The text "August 1, 2021" and "August 11, 2021" are overlaid on each respective image to indicate the date of capture
